title: Bogomolov-Pop pro-ell reconstruction
exact_target: Let K/k and L/l have transcendence degree at least two over arbitrary algebraically closed constants of characteristic different from ell. Does the maximal abelian pro-ell Galois quotient, equipped with its commutator-lifting structure from the abelian-by-central quotient, determine every isomorphism of their perfect closures, with the canonical bijection using Frobenius equivalence on fields and a common $Z_\ell -unit$ scalar on Galois maps?
